enrichment_method.evidence: For cysteine peptide enrichment, dissolved samples were incubated with 100 µL of streptavidin agarose beads (50% v/v) in 1X PBS, pH 7.4, by rotating end‐over‐end for overnight at 4°C to enrich for TMT‐labeled, DBIA‐conjugated cysteine peptides.

fractionation_method.evidence: Non‐cysteine‐containing peptides were fractionated by off‐line high pH HPLC, as described in Table S6, where 17 fractions were collected and lyophilized.

fragmentation_method.evidence: MS2 spectra were acquired by selection of the top ten most abundant features via collisional induced dissociation in the ion trap using an automatic gain control (AGC) setting of 10K, quadrupole isolation width of 0.5 m/z and a maximum ion accumulation time of 35 ms.
